question: Due to the ___________ nature of qualitative research, there is no agreed process in designing a qualitative research project. To this end, researchers can use certain design principles in designing their qualitative projects.
explanation: Keyword: 'NO AGREED PROCESS' / 'QUALITATIVE RESEARCH' -> Chọn A (Unstructured). Nghiên cứu định tính có bản chất phi cấu trúc (Unstructured), linh hoạt và mở, do đó không có một quy trình chuẩn hóa hay cố định duy nhất nào khi thiết kế dự án.

question: All researchers commence their research with an issue or _________, investigate the relevant empirical evidence and literature to identify relevant research evidence which will help in designing the qualitative questions, collect data and analyse them.
explanation: Keyword: 'ISSUE OR _________' -> Chọn A (Solution) theo đáp án tài liệu đề bài (hoặc Problem trong lý thuyết chung). Bắt đúng keyword đề thi cung cấp: 'commence their research with an issue or Solution'.

question: Several aspects of a qualitative research project vary from researcher to researcher. For instance, the empirical evidence and the literature may be reviewed to inform the questions initially raised or it may be reviewed at a late stage during the research process or it may be used to highlight the importance of the research problem. Another consideration regarding qualitative research is the structure and writing of the qualitative project. This varies across different approaches such as ___________ and performances including theatre and poems.
explanation: Keyword: 'PERFORMANCES INCLUDING THEATRE AND POEMS' -> Chọn A (Storytelling). Trong nghiên cứu định tính, cách trình bày kết quả rất đa dạng, đi liền với nghệ thuật kể chuyện (Storytelling) và các hình thức biểu diễn.

question: The in-depth ___________ does not have the restrictions of a group process and in this vein, new streams of ___________and questioning can be developed at any time.
explanation: Keyword: 'IN-DEPTH ___________' / 'NOT RESTRICTIONS OF GROUP' -> Chọn B (Interviews). Cụm từ cố định 'In-depth interviews' (phỏng vấn sâu) diễn ra 1-1 nên hoàn toàn không bị gò bó bởi quy trình hay áp lực nhóm.

question: __________ interviews offer more flexibility and new ways of gathering insights. The close and personal interaction permits the interviewer to be more sensitive and open to nonverbal feedback and body language. With personal interviews, a personal point of view can be gathered without the influence of others. The interview can be conducted in any place and no certain or demanding preparations are needed.
explanation: Keyword: 'CLOSE AND PERSONAL INTERACTION' / 'WITHOUT INFLUENCE OF OTHERS' -> Chọn B (Personal). Phỏng vấn cá nhân (Personal interviews) mang lại tương tác trực tiếp, quan sát được ngôn ngữ cơ thể và thu thập góc nhìn riêng tư không bị chi phối.

question: The success of an in-depth interview depends on the _______ of the interviewer.
explanation: Keyword: 'SUCCESS DEPENDS ON' -> Chọn A (Skills). Sự thành bại của một buổi phỏng vấn sâu phụ thuộc cốt lõi vào KỸ NĂNG (Skills) dẫn dắt, lắng nghe và gợi mở thông tin của người phỏng vấn.

question: The unstructured nature of the interview necessitates the researcher to have the competence in gathering and ___________the information collected.
explanation: Keyword: 'GATHERING AND ___________ INFORMATION' -> Chọn B (Interpreting). Bản chất phi cấu trúc đòi hỏi nhà nghiên cứu không chỉ thu thập mà phải có năng lực GIẢI THÍCH / DIỄN GIẢI (Interpreting) dữ liệu định tính thu được.

question: Survey approaches are based upon the design and development of well _________ questionnaires. Key informants may be asked several questions with respect to their intentions, motivations, attitudes, demographic and lifestyle characteristics among others. The questions may be asked verbally in writing or through a remote device (e.g., laptop) and the responses may be collected through these ways.
explanation: Keyword: 'SURVEY APPROACHES' / 'WELL _________ QUESTIONNAIRES' -> Chọn D (Structured). Phương pháp khảo sát số lượng lớn luôn dựa trên các bảng hỏi ĐƯỢC THIẾT KẾ CÓ CẤU TRÚC RÕ RÀNG (Structured questionnaires).

question: Structured refers to the level of __________ that is used during the data collection procedure.
explanation: Keyword: 'STRUCTURED REFERS TO' -> Chọn A (Standardisation). Tính 'có cấu trúc' (Structured) trong thu thập dữ liệu đồng nghĩa với mức độ CHUẨN HÓA (Standardisation) về câu hỏi và quy trình.

question: In structured data collection a formal research instrument is developed and the different questions are offered in a ___________order.
explanation: Keyword: 'STRUCTURED DATA COLLECTION' / 'QUESTIONS ORDER' -> Chọn A (Pre-arranged). Trong khảo sát có cấu trúc, mọi câu hỏi đều được sắp đặt theo một TRẬT TỰ ĐỊNH SẴN (Pre-arranged order), không ngẫu nhiên.

question: The research can be classified as _________ or __________ based upon whether the objective of the research is known to the respondents.
options: Structured or unstructured|Standardised or random|Fixed or changing|Direct or indirect
explanation: Keyword: 'OBJECTIVE KNOWN TO RESPONDENTS' -> Chọn D (Direct or indirect). Nếu người trả lời biết rõ mục đích nghiên cứu thì là trực tiếp (Direct), nếu bị ẩn mục đích để tránh thiên kiến thì là gián tiếp (Indirect).

question: In a survey questionnaire, the vast majority of questions are _________ responses that require the respondent to select the answer from a prearranged set of responses. For instance, a question designed to operationalise consumer perceptions regarding a product may be read as follows: The nutrition value of product X is high and the answers are anchored in a 5 point Likert type scale ranging from strongly disagree (1) to strongly agree (5).
explanation: Keyword: 'SELECT FROM PREARRANGED SET' -> Chọn D (Fixed). Câu hỏi khảo sát đóng đòi hỏi đáp viên chọn từ các phương án CỐ ĐỊNH SẴN CÓ (Fixed responses) như thang đo Likert.

question: ___________ sampling is a probability sample which is distinguished by the following processes: the original population is divided into two or more mutually exclusive and exhaustive subsets (e.g., males and females) and simple random samples of elements from two or more subsets are selected independently of each other.
explanation: Keyword: 'DIVIDED INTO MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE SUBSETS' -> Chọn D (Stratified). Phân chia tổng thể thành các nhóm nhỏ không trùng lặp (nam/nữ) rồi rút mẫu ngẫu nhiên từ từng nhóm chính là LẤY MẪU PHÂN TẦNG (Stratified sampling).

question: Each element of the population should be allocated to one and only one _________stratum and no population elements should be omitted.
explanation: Keyword: 'ALLOCATED TO ONE AND ONLY ONE' -> Chọn D (Stratum). Trong lấy mẫu phân tầng, mỗi phần tử trong tổng thể chỉ được thuộc về DUY NHẤT MỘT TẦNG (Stratum) xác định.

question: ___________ sampling is a probability sample which is distinguished by the following processes: the original population is divided into two or more mutually exclusive and exhaustive subsets (e.g., males and females) and simple random samples of elements from two or more subsets are selected independently of each other.
explanation: Keyword: 'PROBABILITY SAMPLE' / 'EXCLUSIVE AND EXHAUSTIVE SUBSETS' -> Chọn D (Stratified). Định nghĩa mẫu xác suất phân tầng: chia tổng thể thành các tầng riêng biệt rồi chọn mẫu ngẫu nhiên độc lập.

question: Stratified sampling is a two-step approach where the population is divided into subpopulations or _________.
explanation: Keyword: 'SUBPOPULATIONS OR _________' -> Chọn C (Strata). Lấy mẫu phân tầng là quy trình 2 bước chia quần thể thành các tập con gọi là CÁC TẦNG (Strata - số nhiều của Stratum).

question: In _________ sampling the target population is initially divided to mutually exclusive and collectively exhaustive subpopulations.
explanation: Keyword: 'MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE & COLLECTIVELY EXHAUSTIVE SUBPOPULATIONS' -> Chọn B (Cluster). Lấy mẫu theo cụm (Cluster sampling) chia tổng thể ban đầu thành các cụm đại diện thu nhỏ tương đương nhau.

question: Response rates can be increased through the adoption of __________to research participants.
explanation: Keyword: 'INCREASE RESPONSE RATES' -> Chọn B (Incentives). Tỷ lệ phản hồi khảo sát tăng lên đáng kể khi áp dụng PHẦN THƯỞNG / QUÀ ĐỘNG VIÊN (Incentives) cho người tham gia.

question: A well-developed research instrument can enhance the response rate and reduce ____________ to participate in the research study. If the research instrument and the whole experience in completing the questionnaire is pleasant for the research participants, the response rate can improve.
explanation: Keyword: 'REDUCE ____________ TO PARTICIPATE' -> Chọn A (Refusals). Bảng hỏi được thiết kế khoa học, trải nghiệm thoải mái giúp GIẢM THIỂU TỶ LỆ TỪ CHỐI (Refusals) tham gia nghiên cứu.

question: Well-trained researchers can enhance response rates and increase ____________ and persuasion of key informants. Follow up or contacting the non-respondents periodically, works well in eliminating refusals and convince individuals to participate in the research project. A reminder may be sent to non respondents to complete the questionnaire.
explanation: Keyword: 'INCREASE ____________ AND PERSUASION' -> Chọn B (Conversion). Nghiên cứu viên được đào tạo bài bản giúp tăng TỶ LỆ CHUYỂN ĐỔI (Conversion rate) và khả năng thuyết phục đối tượng tham gia.

question: _________ is defined as the process of identifying constructive associations, patterns and trends emerging from accumulated amounts of collected data stored in repositories, through the adoption of pattern recognition and statistical and mathematical approaches.
explanation: Keyword: 'PATTERNS AND TRENDS FROM ACCUMULATED DATA' -> Chọn A (Data mining). Quá trình tìm kiếm các quy luật, mối quan hệ và xu hướng ẩn từ các kho dữ liệu khổng lồ chính là KHAI PHÁ DỮ LIỆU (Data mining).

question: __________ refer to organisations which gather and sell pools of data and information which are developed to address information requirements and needs.
explanation: Keyword: 'GATHER AND SELL POOLS OF DATA' -> Chọn C (Syndicated sources). Các tổ chức chuyên thu thập và bán các gói dữ liệu thị trường thương mại được gọi là NGUỒN TỔNG HỢP / NGUỒN LIÊN KẾT (Syndicated sources).

question: ____________focus on electronic devices which automatically record behaviour and are supplemented by a diary. Such data are used for creating media programmes on air time and developing viewer profiles.
explanation: Keyword: 'AUTOMATICALLY RECORD BEHAVIOUR & SUPPLEMENTED BY DIARY' -> Chọn A (Diary media panels). Phương pháp kết hợp thiết bị ghi nhận điện tử tự động và nhật ký theo dõi của người xem.

question: Market research assists companies in moving in the right manner, and in this vein, companies can use the collected information in order to improve strategic decision making and to improve customer ____________.
explanation: Keyword: 'IMPROVE STRATEGIC DECISION & CUSTOMER _________' -> Chọn B (Satisfaction). Mục tiêu cốt lõi của nghiên cứu thị trường là hỗ trợ ra quyết định chiến lược và nâng cao SỰ HÀI LÒNG CỦA KHÁCH HÀNG (Customer satisfaction).

question: Gathered market research data should be integrated with other research data coming from both __________ and external sources to make the most of their use and to make more confident strategic decision making.
explanation: Keyword: 'BOTH __________ AND EXTERNAL SOURCES' -> Chọn A (Internal). Để tối ưu giá trị dữ liệu, doanh nghiệp cần kết hợp chặt chẽ cả nguồn NỘI BỘ (Internal) và nguồn bên ngoài (External).

question: The budget scheduled for research should be considered and in this vein, if there are limited research resources more cost efficient ways of collecting data to be considered including __________ data collection approaches. Right market research data assist companies in better connecting with their customers and attract new customers.
explanation: Keyword: 'LIMITED BUDGET' / 'COST EFFICIENT WAYS' -> Chọn C (Automated). Khi ngân sách hạn chế, các phương pháp thu thập dữ liệu TỰ ĐỘNG HÓA (Automated data collection) là giải pháp tiết kiệm chi phí nhất.

question: __________is defined as the procedure of placing key informants to a continuum regarding their attitude towards a certain product or product line.
explanation: Keyword: 'PLACING TO A CONTINUUM REGARDING ATTITUDE' -> Chọn C (Scaling). Quy trình định vị thái độ hoặc cảm nhận của đối tượng lên một dải đo liên tục được gọi là XÂY DỰNG THANG ĐO (Scaling).

question: A _________scale is a figurative labelling scheme in which numbers serve as labels or tags in order to identify and classify objects.
explanation: Keyword: 'NUMBERS SERVE AS LABELS OR TAGS' -> Chọn A (Nominal). Thang đo mà các con số chỉ đóng vai trò làm NHÃN ĐỊNH DANH hoặc phân loại đối tượng chính là THANG ĐO ĐỊNH DANH (Nominal scale).

question: _________scale is a scale where the numbers used to rank objects such as numerically equal distances on the scale demonstrate equal distances in the attribute being measured.
explanation: Keyword: 'NUMERICALLY EQUAL DISTANCES' -> Chọn A (Interval). Thang đo mà khoảng cách số học bằng nhau thể hiện đúng khoảng cách thuộc tính đo lường bằng nhau là THANG ĐO KHOẢNG (Interval scale).

question: __________scaling focuses on two objects which the respondents are asked to select one according to some criterion.
explanation: Keyword: 'TWO OBJECTS' / 'SELECT ONE' -> Chọn A (Paired comparison). Phương pháp yêu cầu người tham gia chọn 1 trong 2 đối tượng dựa theo tiêu chí nhất định là SO SÁNH CẶP (Paired comparison scaling).

question: The development of a ___________scale commences with a concept which should be rated, such as the image of a brand or the quality of a service. The market researcher chooses opposite pairs of words or phrases (for instance, reliable (1) to unreliable (7)) which could be used to capture the concept. As a next step, respondents rate the concept on a scale which is usually anchored from 1 to 7.
explanation: Keyword: 'OPPOSITE PAIRS OF WORDS' (1 TO 7) -> Chọn B (Semantic differential). Thang đo sử dụng CÁC CẶP TỪ TRÁI NGHĨA (ví dụ: đáng tin - không đáng tin) ở hai đầu cực gọi là Thang đo đối cực (Semantic differential scale).

question: In _________scale a single adjective (e.g., user friendly, high quality) is located in the centre of the scale which usually is a 10 point scale that ranges from +5 to -5. The approach is designed to operationalise the direction and the intensity of the attitudes at the same time.
explanation: Keyword: 'SINGLE ADJECTIVE IN CENTRE' (+5 TO -5) -> Chọn B (Stapel). Thang đo đặt một TÍNH TỪ ĐƠN LẺ Ở GIỮA với dải điểm đối xứng từ +5 đến -5 để đo cả hướng và cường độ thái độ là THANG ĐO STAPEL.

question: The _______scale consists of a number of statements that communicate a favourable or unfavourable attitude toward the concept that is under investigation.
explanation: Keyword: 'STATEMENTS OF FAVOURABLE OR UNFAVOURABLE ATTITUDE' -> Chọn B (Likert). Thang đo LIKERT gồm các câu phát biểu để đối tượng đánh giá mức độ đồng tình hay phản đối từ thấp đến cao.

question: Under the spectrum of a ___________case study, the researcher concentrates on an issue or concern and as a next step chooses a bounded case study to depict the case.
explanation: Keyword: 'BOUNDED CASE TO DEPICT THE ISSUE' -> Chọn C (Single instrumental). Nghiên cứu trường hợp công cụ đơn (Single instrumental case study) tập trung vào một vấn đề rồi chọn đúng 1 tình huống cụ thể làm minh họa.

question: In a collective case study or _________case study the issue to be investigated is selected but the researcher chooses a number of case studies to depict the issue. Such an action helps to investigate different aspects of the issue under investigation.
explanation: Keyword: 'A NUMBER OF CASE STUDIES' / 'COLLECTIVE' -> Chọn D (Multiple). Nghiên cứu đa trường hợp (Multiple / Collective case study) khảo sát nhiều tình huống khác nhau để làm rõ toàn diện vấn đề.

question: Qualitative researchers are reluctant to generalise the cases from one context to another because the contexts of the various cases are different. If the intention is to generalise, the qualitative researcher should select ____________ cases to be considered in the qualitative study.
explanation: Keyword: 'INTENTION IS TO GENERALISE' -> Chọn A (Representative). Nếu muốn khái quát hóa kết quả định tính, nhà nghiên cứu bắt buộc phải chọn CÁC TRƯỜNG HỢP CÓ TÍNH ĐẠI DIỆN CAO (Representative cases).

question: Phenomenologists identify a phenomenon which serves as an object or the unit of analysis and is related to an individual ___________.
explanation: Keyword: 'PHENOMENOLOGISTS' / 'INDIVIDUAL _________' -> Chọn A (Experience). Bản chất của nghiên cứu hiện tượng học (Phenomenology) là tìm hiểu sâu về TRẢI NGHIỆM SỐNG THỰC TẾ (Lived experience) của cá nhân.

question: The combination of both the ___________ and structural descriptions offer the whole essence of the experience with the phenomenon.
explanation: Keyword: 'COMBINATION OF STRUCTURAL AND _________' -> Chọn A (Textural). Bản chất cốt lõi của hiện tượng học là sự hợp nhất giữa mô tả kết cấu (Textural - trải nghiệm cái gì) và mô tả cấu trúc (Structural - trải nghiệm như thế nào).

question: The __________process is based upon the stages of the action research cycle which consists of a number of different stages.
explanation: Keyword: 'STAGES OF ACTION RESEARCH CYCLE' -> Chọn A (Action research). Quy trình nghiên cứu hành động (Action research) diễn ra theo chu kỳ vòng lặp liên tục gồm: lập kế hoạch -> hành động -> quan sát -> phản tư.

question: In action research, it is essential to construct the initiative with pertinent stakeholders and to produce and gather research data regarding an ongoing system that is relevant to an objective or a need or requirement; _________with others in order to review the data which was collected.
explanation: Keyword: 'ACTION RESEARCH' / '_________ WITH OTHERS' -> Chọn A (Engaging). Nghiên cứu hành động đề cao tính hợp tác, đòi hỏi sự GẮN KẾT VÀ TƯƠNG TÁC SÂU SẮC (Engaging) cùng các bên liên quan.

question: Two popular types of ethnography include realist ethnography and _________ ethnography.
explanation: Keyword: 'TWO TYPES OF ETHNOGRAPHY' -> Chọn D (Critical). Hai trường phái dân tộc học phổ biến nhất là Dân tộc học thực tế (Realist ethnography) và Dân tộc học phê phán (Critical ethnography).

question: _________ethnography represents an objective picture of a situation such as customer reactions towards a branded product, with the objective of reporting the information learned by research participants in the research field. Under this type of ethnography, the ethnographer narrates the study in third-person and objectively reports what has been discovered by the research participants. The researcher reports the collected information without any personal bias. The ethnographer generates the research participants point of view by using carefully edited quotations and should objectively communicate and interpret the group culture that is being analysed.
explanation: Keyword: 'OBJECTIVE PICTURE' / 'THIRD-PERSON NARRATION' -> Chọn C (Realist). Dân tộc học thực tế (Realist ethnography) thuật lại góc nhìn khách quan ở ngôi thứ ba, loại bỏ tối đa định kiến chủ quan của nhà nghiên cứu.

question: Critical ethnography is researchers who are politically minded people who aim to use their research to speak against ___________. Critical ethnographers may research brands and their relationships with customers. Ethnographic research can offer an accurate understanding of consumer behaviour which helps with the modelling of branding as it is socially perceived by consumers.
explanation: Keyword: 'CRITICAL ETHNOGRAPHY' / 'SPEAK AGAINST _________' -> Chọn B (Inequality). Dân tộc học phê phán (Critical ethnography) mang khuynh hướng chính trị xã hội, dùng nghiên cứu để cất lên tiếng nói CHỐNG LẠI BẤT BÌNH ĐẲNG (Inequality) và quyền lực áp bức.

question: Which of the following statements about research are valid?
options: Research has to be purely speculative, disconnected from practical concerns that would only be distractions.|Research is only inspired by practical problems observed in the physical world.|Research is only a hobby of talented individuals, who can afford investing their time and effort in it.|Research may generate new knowledge. New knowledge may generate innovations that may favor progress of society.|Research does not require other investments than salaries for researchers.
explanation: Keyword: 'NEW KNOWLEDGE -> INNOVATIONS -> PROGRESS' -> Chọn D. Nghiên cứu tạo ra tri thức mới, từ đó nảy sinh các đổi mới sáng tạo thúc đẩy sự tiến bộ của toàn xã hội.

question: Which of the following statements about societal investments in research are valid?
options: Research is a luxury. Investments are only justified in periods of economic growth.|Society invests in research as a way to reduce unemployment.|Research is a burden for taxpayers. Investments in research should only be made if achievement of practically useful results is guaranteed upfront.|Investments are made because research can lead to useful innovations and progress of society.|Society invests in research because it may generate new knowledge and knowledge is a human aspiration.
explanation: Keyword: 'SOCIETAL INVESTMENTS' -> Chọn D & E. Xã hội đầu tư nghiên cứu vì: (D) dẫn đến cải tiến tiến bộ xã hội và (E) tri thức mới là khát vọng tự nhiên của nhân loại.

question: This question is about originality. When can a research result be defined original?
options: The research result was not known before.|The process through which the research lead to the result is novel.|The research result can lead to a useful product.|The research result was unexpected.|The research result was very hard to achieve.
explanation: Keyword: 'ORIGINALITY' -> Chọn A, B, D (theo dữ liệu kiểm tra đáp án đề thi). Kết quả nguyên bản khi: kết quả chưa từng biết trước đây (A), quy trình tạo ra kết quả mới mẻ (B), hoặc kết quả bất ngờ (D).

question: This question is about significance. When can a research result be defined significant?
options: The research result was unexpected.|The research result may be used by other researchers to advance their research.|The research result was not known before.|The research that produced the result required a very substantial funding.|The research result may lead to an improvement of a certain practical process, which reduces its cost and improves its performance.
explanation: Keyword: 'SIGNIFICANCE' -> Chọn B & E. Ý nghĩa (Significance) thể hiện khi: (B) người khác dùng để phát triển nghiên cứu tiếp theo, hoặc (E) cải tiến thực tiễn giúp giảm chi phí/tăng hiệu năng.

question: This question is about rigor. When can a research result be defined rigorous?
options: The research result is properly formalized in mathematical form, and definitions and proofs are described clearly, correctly, and elegantly.|The research result is a new artifact, whose design and validation are clearly and thoroughly described.|The research result may be used by other researchers to advance their own research.|The research result solves an open problem that has been studied for many years.|The research result is of theoretical nature.
explanation: Keyword: 'RIGOR' -> Chọn A & B. Tính nghiêm ngặt (Rigor) thể hiện qua: (A) công thức hóa toán học và chứng minh chặt chẽ, hoặc (B) sản phẩm mới có thiết kế và kiểm chứng rõ ràng.

question: Which of the following statements about the distinction between basic and applied research are acceptable?
options: Basic research only requires \paper and pencil\". No special equipment is needed.|The spectrum between basic and applied research is continuous and a researcher may engage in both kinds of research during his/her work.|Basic research inevitably leads to discoveries that can then be transformed by applied research into practical industrial innovations.|Basic research is so fundamentally different from applied research that a researcher has to specialize and choose between the two upfront.|Applied research is a less valuable (and prestigious) kind of research than basic research."
explanation: Keyword: 'BASIC VS APPLIED' / 'CONTINUOUS SPECTRUM' -> Chọn B. Ranh giới giữa nghiên cứu cơ bản và nghiên cứu ứng dụng là một dải liên tục (continuous spectrum), nhà nghiên cứu có thể làm song song cả hai.

question: Which of the following statements about funded research programs are appropriate?
options: A top-down research program only funds research that aims at an empirical evaluation in a practical setting of previously achieved theoretical results.|A bottom-up research program allows researchers to select any possible research topic, and proposals are selected for funding only based on their originality, significance, and rigor.|A top-down research program defines precisely the research topics that can be funded and should be addressed by applicants.|A bottom-up research program only supports research that is motivated by current, practical needs of industry.|A top-down research program gives researcher maximum freedom in selecting research topics.
explanation: Keyword: 'TOP-DOWN VS BOTTOM-UP' -> Chọn B & C. (B) Bottom-up cho phép tự do chọn đề tài và đánh giá trên chất lượng; (C) Top-down ấn định chính xác các chủ đề ưu tiên cần giải quyết.

question: Tick one or more of the following statements, which properly describes the scientific method, originated in the 17th century by scientists like Galileo, Newton, and others.
options: The method assures that a certain theory explaining a natural phenomenon is valid (i.e., it is an undisputable truth) after carefully chosen experiments confirm it.|The method is purely theoretical, and does not require any experiments.|The method consists of observing a natural phenomenon under study, postulating a theory that explains it, and devising carefully chosen experiments to confirm or disprove the theory.|The method is based on validation of a theory by randomly generated experiments.|The method requires explaining the natural phenomenon under study avoiding the use of mathematics
explanation: Keyword: 'SCIENTIFIC METHOD' -> Chọn C. Phương pháp khoa học chuẩn: Quan sát hiện tượng -> Đặt ra lý thuyết giải thích -> Thiết kế thực nghiệm kiểm chứng hoặc bác bỏ.

question: What is a null hypothesis? Tick the correct answer.
options: Hypothesis that further experiments disprove.|An obviously wrong hypothesis that does not explain a certain phenomenon.|No hypothesis made.|Hypothesis made by inexperienced scientist.|Hypothesis framed in a negative form, which researchers try to reject to confirm a theory.
explanation: Keyword: 'NULL HYPOTHESIS' / 'TRY TO REJECT' -> Chọn E. Giả thuyết không (H0) được phát biểu ở dạng phủ định (negative form) mà nhà nghiên cứu thu thập dữ liệu nhằm mục đích BÁC BỎ để củng cố lý thuyết.

question: A scientific theory... (tick one)
options: Is guaranteed to be unfalsifiable when it is published.|Is valid until further findings disprove it.|Is valid if a majority vote of researchers approves it.|Must be stated as an absolute truth. It is guaranteed that it will never be falsified by further experiments.|Must always be described as a set of mathematical formulae.
explanation: Keyword: 'VALID UNTIL DISPROVED' -> Chọn B (lưu ý đề thi đánh dấu Not Correct cho phương án đơn lẻ này khi muốn chỉ ra tính tạm thời). Về nguyên lý khoa học: Một lý thuyết chỉ có giá trị cho tới khi có bằng chứng mới bác bỏ nó.

question: Deduction vs. induction. Tick the correct statements:
options: Deductive inferences can be used to generate predictions from a given theory.|Modus ponens is a typical deductive inference rule.|In deductive inference, the consequences of true premises must be further validated by experiments before they can be accepted as a truth.|In deductive inference, the consequences are guaranteed to be true if premises are true.|Inductive inferences always lead to necessary conclusions.
explanation: Keyword: 'DEDUCTION' (DIỄN DỊCH) -> Chọn A, B, D. Diễn dịch: (A) dùng dự đoán từ lý thuyết, (B) luật Modus Ponens là chuẩn mực, và (D) tiền đề đúng thì kết luận chắc chắn đúng.

question: Consider the following statements: All beans in the bag are white, These beans are from the bag, These beans are white. Which of the following statements about inferences are correct?
options: The inference rule b ∧c ⊢ a is an induction and leads to a non-necessary conclusion.|The inference rule a ∧ b ⊢ c is a deduction and leads to a necessary conclusion.|The inference rule b ∧c ⊢ a is a deduction and leads to a necessary conclusion.|The inference rule a ∧c ⊢ b is an deduction and leads to a necessary conclusion.|The inference rule a ∧c ⊢ b is an induction and leads to a non-necessary conclusion.
explanation: Keyword: 'BEANS IN THE BAG INFERENCES' -> Chọn A & B. a ∧ b ⊢ c là diễn dịch (deduction) mang tính tất yếu; b ∧ c ⊢ a là quy nạp (induction) mang tính không tất yếu.

question: Soundness vs. completeness of a theory of a certain phenomenon. Tick the correct statements.
options: A theory for a given phenomenon is complete if all its predictions are possible manifestations of the phenomenon.|A theory for a given phenomenon is complete if it predicts all the possible manifestations.|A complete theory for a given phenomenon can predict impossible manifestations.|Ideally, a theory should be both sound and complete.|A theory for a given phenomenon is sound if all its predictions are possible manifestations of the phenomenon.
explanation: Keyword: 'SOUNDNESS & COMPLETENESS' -> Chọn B, D, E. Đầy đủ (Complete - B): dự đoán MỌI biểu hiện có thể; Đúng đắn (Sound - E): mọi dự đoán ĐỀU LÀ biểu hiện có thật; Lý tưởng (D): thỏa mãn cả hai.

question: Consider the following statements about precision and recall of an algorithm. Which are correct?
options: Either precision or recall must be equal to one for an approximate algorithm to be acceptable.|Precision is less than one for algorithms that compute false positives.|If we are given two approximate algorithms for the same problem, they can they differ in precision and recall.|Recall is less than one for algorithms that produce false negatives.|Precision and recall are equal to one for algorithms computing exact solutions.
explanation: Keyword: 'PRECISION & RECALL' -> Chọn B, C, D, E. Precision < 1 khi có dương tính giả (B); Recall < 1 khi có âm tính giả (D); giải thuật chính xác tuyệt đối có Precision = Recall = 1 (E).

question: Consider the following statements about case studies in research. Tick the pertinent answers.
options: A case study is never applied in research. It is only used as a didactic aid.|A case study is a study of a legal action.|A case study never requires threat analysis.|Threat analysis should be applied to assess internal and external validity of the conclusions drawn from a case study.|A case study may concern the use of a proposed new artifact or method in a given context to validate its usability in a practical setting.
explanation: Keyword: 'CASE STUDY THREAT ANALYSIS & ARTIFACT' -> Chọn D & E. Trong case study: (D) Bắt buộc phân tích mối đe dọa (threat analysis) đến độ giá trị; (E) Dùng để kiểm chứng thực tế giải pháp mới.

question: Consider an algorithm that is supposed to find all possible occurrences in a text of person's names. We are aware of the difficulty of the problem, and we expect the algorithm to provide an approximate solution. In some cases, understanding whether a word represents a person's name may in fact require deep semantic understanding of the text. Being an approximation, the algorithm may provide false positives and false negatives. Which of the following statements are correct?
options: The algorithm finds a name that is not a person's name. This is a false negative.|The algorithm finds a name that is not a person's name. This is a false positive.|The algorithm may both find a name that is not a person's name and may fail to find the occurrence of certain person's names. In this case the algorithm is simply an unacceptable approximation.|The algorithm may find a name that is not a person's name and may fail to find the occurrence of certain person's names. In this case the algorithm can generate both false positives and false negatives.|The algorithm does not find the occurrence of certain person's names. This is a false positive.
explanation: Keyword: 'FALSE POSITIVE & FALSE NEGATIVE' -> Chọn B & D. Nhận nhầm từ không phải tên người là Dương tính giả (False positive - B); thuật toán xấp xỉ có thể sinh ra cả hai lỗi này cùng lúc (D).

question: You are asked to review a survey paper. In which of the following dimensions you are not expecting the paper to be particularly strong? Tick one.
explanation: Keyword: 'SURVEY PAPER' / 'NOT EXPECTING STRONG' -> Chọn A (Originality). Bài báo tổng quan (Survey/Review paper) tổng hợp kiến thức đã có nên KHÔNG YÊU CẦU CAO VỀ TÍNH NGUYÊN BẢN (Originality), mà cần tính bao quát và nghiêm ngặt.

question: You are asked to review a theoretical research paper. In which of the following quality dimensions you expect the paper to be particularly strong? Tick one.
explanation: Keyword: 'THEORETICAL PAPER' / 'PARTICULARLY STRONG' -> Chọn A (Rigor). Bài báo nghiên cứu lý thuyết thuần túy đòi hỏi cao nhất ở TÍNH NGHIÊM NGẶT (Rigor) trong chứng minh toán học và lập luận logic.

question: The following statements are about journal and conference publication. Tick the ones that are valid:
options: Journals are always more selective and prestigious venues than conferences.|The publication process for conferences normally takes longer than for journals, and duration can be unpredictable.|The publication process for journals normally takes longer than for conferences, and duration can be unpredictable.|In certain scientific areas conferences and journals are equally selective and respected publication venues.|Conference publication has no scientific value. It is only done as a social activity. This is true for all scientific areas.
explanation: Keyword: 'JOURNALS VS CONFERENCES' -> Chọn C & D. (C) Tạp chí xuất bản lâu và khó đoán hơn hội thảo; (D) Ở một số ngành như CNTT/Khoa học máy tính, hội thảo uy tín ngang hàng tạp chí.

question: The publication process relies on peer review. Which of the following statements are valid? Tick them.
options: Peer review is a voluntary service activity done to support the research community.|To reach better insights into a submitted paper, it is advisable that peer review is delegated to close colleagues of the authors, especially those who have been previous collaborators.|The goal of peer review is to ensure that published results meet certain quality standards.|The main goal of peer review is to ensure proper balance among different nationalities of contributors of accepted papers.|To avoid bias, peer reviewers should not be experts in the field of the contribution.
explanation: Keyword: 'PEER REVIEW PURPOSE' -> Chọn A & C. Phản biện ngang hàng: (A) là hoạt động cống hiến tự nguyện cho cộng đồng học thuật, và (C) mục tiêu là đảm bảo chất lượng bài báo đạt chuẩn.

question: Which of the following are valid statements about peer review? Tick them.
options: In a \double blind\" review process not only the identity of the reviewers is undisclosed to the authors
correctAnswer: but also the identity of the authors is hidden to the reviewers
explanation: to reduce bias.|The typical situation is that the identity of reviewers is unknown to the author of a submitted paper.|A \"double blind\" review process allows authors to submit two related papers to the same venue and have them reviewed by the same set of anonymous reviewers.|The typical situation is that the author of a paper knows the identity of peer reviewers and interacts with them throughout the review process
column7: if necessary.|A \"double blind\" review process requires exactly two anonymous reviewers for each submitted paper."
column9: Keyword: 'DOUBLE BLIND REVIEW' -> Chọn A & B. (A) Double-blind ẩn danh tính cả hai chiều (tác giả và phản biện); (B) Trong quy trình chuẩn thông thường thì tác giả không biết ai phản biện bài mình.

question: Which of the following are valid statements about publications? Tick them.
options: Every published book is uniquely identified by its ISBN.|Most professional societies publish journals and conference proceedings in their respective technical areas.|A DOI allows unique access to digital objects, including papers and datasets.|Publication has a legal purpose: it ensures 100% correctness of the reported results.|The only possible form of publication is in printed form.
explanation: Keyword: 'PUBLICATIONS IDENTIFIERS (ISBN, DOI)' -> Chọn A, B, C. (A) Sách định danh bằng ISBN; (B) Các hội nghề nghiệp xuất bản kỷ yếu/tạp chí chuyên ngành; (C) DOI định danh điện tử bài báo và dữ liệu.

question: Which of the following statements about research artifacts are valid? Tick them.
options: Research artifacts can be an essential complement to papers as a form of research diffusion.|Making artifacts publicly available requires additional effort by researchers. As a benefit, their research may become more visible and their research impactful.|Repeatability and replicability of research is supported by sharing artifacts.|Peer review only applies to papers. Artifacts cannot be peer reviewed.|Research artifacts, such as datasets, software tools, or simulations, only serve an ancillary purpose in the preparation of a paper and should be kept private. They have no use for others.
explanation: Keyword: 'RESEARCH ARTIFACTS' -> Chọn A, B, C. Sản phẩm nghiên cứu (mã nguồn, dữ liệu): (A) bổ trợ cho bài báo, (B) tăng tầm ảnh hưởng nghiên cứu, và (C) hỗ trợ khả năng lặp lại/tái lập kết quả (replicability).

question: Which of the following statements about Open Access are valid? Tick them.
options: Open Access means that a research product is accessible on-line in digital form, only subject to a minimal access fee.|Open Access means that a research product is accessible on-line in digital form, free of charge, and free of \most\" copyright and licensing restrictions.|In an Open Access scheme
correctAnswer: authors can publish papers without undergoing any form of peer review.|The notion of Open Access only applies to research papers and not to artifacts.|No implementation of Open Access can charge a fee to a researcher to publish her product."
column7: Keyword: 'OPEN ACCESS DEFINITION' -> Chọn B. Truy cập mở nghĩa là tài liệu được công khai trực tuyến HOÀN TOÀN MIỄN PHÍ (free of charge) và gỡ bỏ hầu hết rào cản bản quyền/cấp phép.

question: Gold vs Green Open Access: which statements are correct? Tick them.
options: Gold Open Access is a special label indicating the most downloaded papers from an online archive.|A Green Open Access journal allows the author to publish a paper and share it with a selected set of people who must register to get access to it.|A Green Open Access journal allows the author to publish a paper l and then charge for accessing the related artifacts.|Gold Open Access means that the author publishes his or her work on an Open Access journal, which makes the work immediately, publicly, and freely available to others.|A Green Open Access journal allows the author to publish a paper and then self-archive a copy in a freely accessible institutional or specialist online archive (e.g., arXiv), or on the personal website.
explanation: Keyword: 'GOLD VS GREEN OPEN ACCESS' -> Chọn A & E (theo dữ liệu kiểm tra đáp án đề thi). Lưu ý lý thuyết chuẩn: Gold là tạp chí mở ngay lập tức (D), Green là tác giả tự lưu trữ bản thảo lên kho lưu trữ tự do (E).

question: How can we judge whether one is fit for research? Tick the pertinent answers.
options: Interest in independent work.|Interest in a job that will make one rich.|Ability to think out of the box.|Persistence in achieving results.
explanation: Keyword: 'FIT FOR RESEARCH' -> Chọn A, C, D. Phù hợp làm nghiên cứu khi: (A) thích làm việc độc lập, (C) có tư duy đột phá (out of the box), và (D) kiên trì bền bỉ theo đuổi kết quả; không phải vì muốn làm giàu nhanh.

question: Consider the following factors one may consider when choosing to enter a PhD program. Tick the three most important.
options: Lively and competitive research environment.|No checks on progress made by the department.|Short distance from home.|Presence of strong researchers in the areas in which you would like to work.|Funding available for salary and travel.
explanation: Keyword: 'CHOOSE PHD PROGRAM' -> Chọn A, D, E. Ba yếu tố then chốt khi chọn học tiến sĩ: (A) Môi trường năng động, (D) Có giáo sư giỏi dẫn dắt, và (E) Có sẵn học bổng/nguồn tài trợ tài chính.

question: This is a list of possible goals of a PhD student. Tick the three most important.
options: Publish as many papers as possible.|Work in complete isolation, to just focus on your own research.|Find opportunities to get some teaching experience and/or student supervision.|Make the software tool you develop as part of your research a visible and impactful artifact, downloaded by a large number of other researchers|Publish in top venues.
explanation: Keyword: 'GOALS OF PHD STUDENT' -> Chọn C, D, E. Mục tiêu cốt lõi của NCS: (C) tích lũy kinh nghiệm giảng dạy/hướng dẫn, (D) tạo ra sản phẩm/công cụ có ảnh hưởng lớn, và (E) xuất bản ở các diễn đàn hàng đầu (top venues).

question: These are statements about networking as a PhD student. Tick the two most pertinent.
options: You should only network for social events with the other PhD students inside your department.|Networking is only a distraction from your main activity, which is doing research.|By networking, you may become known to other, more experienced researchers who may help you in the future (e.g., write reference letters for you).|Networking is only important when required by the funding agency supporting the research, as in the case of multi-site research programs.|Networking allows you to establish possible research collaborations.
explanation: Keyword: 'NETWORKING AS PHD STUDENT' -> Chọn C & E. Kết nối mạng lưới học thuật giúp: (C) được chuyên gia đầu ngành biết đến để xin thư giới thiệu, và (E) mở ra cơ hội hợp tác nghiên cứu.

question: These are statements about research funding. Tick the three most pertinent.
options: Research funding is only needed to support acquisition of expensive research equipment.|Success in competitive research funding programs is an important achievement, which counts in a researcher's evaluation for hiring or promotion.|Successful competition in research funding programs can be vital for a researcher's progress because in most cases their appointment does not include a research funding budget.|Research is a purely intellectual activity. Funding may be needed only to cover a researcher's salary, if no other institution covers it.|Research funding is highly competitive.
explanation: Keyword: 'RESEARCH FUNDING' -> Chọn B, C, E. Tài trợ nghiên cứu: (B) tiêu chí quan trọng để bổ nhiệm/thăng chức, (C) duy trì nghiên cứu do trường không cấp sẵn ngân sách, và (E) có tính cạnh tranh rất cao.

question: These are possible achievements of a junior researcher who is applying for a tenure-track position in a research-oriented academic environment. Tick the three most relevant for hiring.
options: Advisor of Master students in research projects.|Very prolific author of papers published in average-quality venues with high acceptance rate.|Author of a very impactful paper, which describes a solution to an important open problem.|Presenter of papers in average-quality conferences.|Successful applicant in a very selective research funding program.
explanation: Keyword: 'TENURE-TRACK ACHIEVEMENTS' -> Chọn A, C, E. Thành tựu giá trị nhất khi xét tuyển tenure-track: (A) kinh nghiệm hướng dẫn học viên, (C) có bài báo đột phá giải quyết bài toán lớn, và (E) trúng tuyển quỹ tài trợ cạnh tranh.

question: A junior researcher, after the PhD and a short period as a post-doc, applies for junior tenure-track position in an academic institution. Reference letters are asked to external experts. Tick the items in the following list which are expected to be in a reference letter.
options: Comparison of scientific achievements of the candidate with top individuals in the same field with similar seniority.|In the case where the expert is an editor of a journal and the candidate acted as a peer reviewer, comments on how accurate and helpful the reviews were.|Comments on the applicant's presentation skills based on personal experience (e.g., having heard the candidate present in a conference or in a seminar).|A justified opinion about the candidate's potential to become a research leader in his/her area.|Comments on the applicant's personal life (e.g., family, hobbies, ...).
explanation: Keyword: 'REFERENCE LETTER CONTENT' -> Chọn A, B, C, D. Thư giới thiệu học thuật chuyên nghiệp đánh giá: (A) so sánh thành tựu chuyên môn, (B) kỹ năng phản biện, (C) kỹ năng thuyết trình, và (D) tiềm năng dẫn dắt; không nhận xét đời tư cá nhân (E).

question: Consider the case where a researcher applies for promotion from a non-permanent to a permanent academic position. The following statements refer to reference letters asked to external experts to support the promotion case. Tick the pertinent statements.
options: Reference letters should only be asked to scientists who have worked directly with the candidate in the past.|Reference letters should never comment on the candidate's performance as a peer reviewer.|The applicant can suggest names of potential external reviewers and should select well known and respected scientists who are familiar with his work and who are likely to express a positive opinion.|The applicant can suggest names of potential external reviewers and should select among scientists from other institutions who are not familiar with his work.|Reference letter should contain an assessment of the candidate's proven skills as a supervisor and mentor of younger researchers.
explanation: Keyword: 'PROMOTION REFERENCE LETTERS' -> Chọn C & E. Khi xét chức danh biên chế vĩnh viễn: (C) ứng viên được đề xuất chuyên gia uy tín nắm rõ công trình của mình, và (E) thư cần đánh giá năng lực hướng dẫn/cố vấn (mentorship).

question: Which of the following statements on paper citations are valid? Tick them.
options: The number of citations received by a paper precisely measures impact of the research presented in a paper. If two papers have different numbers of citations, the one with a higher number has more scientific impact than the other.|The previous statement is true if we exclude self-citations|The sole number of citations received by a paper does not offer any ground for judgement about its quality.|The previous statement is true if we also assume that the two papers have been published in the same venue and in the same year.|A paper which did not receive citations, or only received a few, ten years after publication is likely to have very low significance. This, however, has to be confirmed by further scrutiny.
explanation: Keyword: 'PAPER CITATIONS' -> Chọn C & E. (C) Chỉ riêng số lượng trích dẫn KHÔNG đủ cơ sở phán xét chất lượng bài báo; (E) Một bài sau 10 năm hầu như không có trích dẫn nhiều khả năng có ít ý nghĩa khoa học.

question: Which of the following statements on Impact Factor (IF) are valid? Tick them.
options: IF cannot be applied to conferences.|IF for a journal is a constant value. It does not change over time.|IF is an objective and undisputable measure of the scientific reputation of a journal and should replace any subjective judgement of experts. If two journals have even slightly different IF values, a researcher should always try to publish in the one with higher IF.|IF is an aggregate bibliometric indicator which is ultimately based the citations of papers published in a journal or conference.|If two papers are published by journals with different IF, the paper published in the journal with higher IF has a higher quality.
explanation: Keyword: 'IMPACT FACTOR (IF) AGGREGATE' -> Chọn D. Impact Factor (IF) là chỉ số trắc lượng thư mục tổng hợp (aggregate bibliometric indicator) tính dựa trên số lượt trích dẫn trung bình của các bài báo xuất bản.

question: Which of the following statements on H-index are valid? Tick them.
options: H-index for a researcher X is defined as the maximum value of h such that X has published h papers that have each been cited at least h times.|H-index for a researcher X is defined as the average value h of citations received by all published papers by the researcher in the past ten years.|H-index is an objective and undisputable measure of the scientific quality of researchers and should replace any subjective judgement of experts, especially when they are involved in hiring or promotion processes. If two candidates have different H-index values, the one with higher H-index should always be ranked higher.|H-index for a researcher X is defined as the median value h of citations received by all published papers by the researcher in the past ten years.|H-index is a bibliometric indicator that applies to researchers.
explanation: Keyword: 'H-INDEX DEFINITION' -> Chọn A & E. (A) H-index là số h cực đại sao cho tác giả có h bài báo được trích dẫn ít nhất h lần; (E) là chỉ số trắc lượng dành riêng để đánh giá cá nhân nhà nghiên cứu.

question: Which of the following statements on quantitative evaluation via bibliometrics are valid? Tick them.
options: Bibliometric indicators can be used to inform evaluation, but should never be a substitute for personal, detailed, and rigorous judgement by experts.|A strength of bibliometrics is that all sources of bibliometric data (such as Google Scholar, ISI Web of Science, and Scopus) provide identical values for the same item (e.g., H-index).|Bibliometric data are especially valuable for cross-sector comparisons. For example, to decide about allocation of funding among very different sectors (such as Mechanical Engineering or Biology) a reasonable choice might be to assess the average quality of researchers in the different sectors (e.g., averaging H-indexes) and allocate funding accordingly.|Bibliometric indicators have no bias: they are objective, undisputable, and cannot be tweaked.|Ultimately, bibliometric indicators are automatically computed numbers and may be used for automatic ranking. Despite minor pitfalls, they are always preferable to human judgement.
explanation: Keyword: 'BIBLIOMETRICS VS HUMAN EXPERT JUDGEMENT' -> Chọn A. Chỉ số trắc lượng thư mục chỉ dùng làm thông tin tham khảo, TUYỆT ĐỐI KHÔNG THAY THẾ đánh giá chuyên môn sâu sắc và nghiêm ngặt của con người/chuyên gia.

question: Which of the following statements on ethics are correct? Tick them.
options: Ethics is the philosophical study of wrong and right conduct, according to an ideal model.|Ethics is the philosophical study of beauty and taste.|A misconduct is a deviation from ethical principles.|Ethical principles do not apply to scientific research.|Misconducts can differ in severity.
explanation: Keyword: 'ETHICS & MISCONDUCT' -> Chọn A, C, E. Đạo đức học: (A) nghiên cứu về hành vi đúng/sai; (C) sai phạm (misconduct) là sự đi chệch khỏi quy chuẩn đạo đức; (E) các mức độ sai phạm có sự khác nhau về độ nghiêm trọng.

question: Which of the following statements on research misconduct are correct? Tick them.
options: Reporting results of a made-up experiment that has never been done is a case of fabrication misconduct.|A falsification misconduct may consist of designing experiments that try to falsify a theory.|Fabrication is a research misconduct that refers to artifacts. It means that an artifact has defects and cannot be reused by other researchers.|A submitted paper that reports fabricated data must be rejected.|Manually tweaking some experimental results to make experiments look better is a case of falsification misconduct.
explanation: Keyword: 'FABRICATION & FALSIFICATION' -> Chọn A & E. Bịa đặt kết quả thí nghiệm chưa từng làm là NGỤY TẠO (Fabrication - A); chỉnh sửa số liệu cho đẹp hơn thực tế là GIẢ MẠO (Falsification - E).

question: Which of the following statements on plagiarism are correct? Tick them.
options: Including figures from other papers can be done without giving credit. Copying figures is not a case of plagiarism.|Including in a paper fragments of text from a paper by other authors, without giving credit, is an example of plagiarism.|Plagiarism consists of not explicitly citing a highly related previously published paper.|Whatever is found on electronic archives through Web browsing can be freely included in own papers without incurring in plagiarism.|An author is allowed to copy text portions from a previous own paper into a new paper and is not required to cite the original paper. Because these texts are from the same author, this is not a case of plagiarism.
explanation: Keyword: 'PLAGIARISM' -> Chọn E (lưu ý đề thi đánh dấu Not Correct cho phương án này vì sao chép bài cũ của chính mình mà không trích dẫn là Tự đạo văn - Self-plagiarism).

question: Which of the following behaviors are clearly unethical? Tick them.
options: One of your students helped you in implementing a simulation, whose results will appear in the experimental section of your paper. He is not listed as a co-author, but you decide to explicitly mention her in an acknowledgements section.|A visiting researcher in your department gives a seminar on her on-going work and mentions a conjecture. She believes that a mathematical proof exists for it, but has not properly demonstrated it. You come out with a proof and submit a paper without citing her idea.|One of your junior colleagues will soon be evaluated for promotion to a tenured position, and needs to strengthen his CV with more publications. To help him, you tell your PhD student who has done very good work to write a paper which includes also your colleague as a co-author, although he has not contributed.|You review a paper in an area in which you are active and have already published. The paper under review has no specific relation with your earlier contributions; it just happens to be in the same general area. You strongly object to publication and ask for a major revision, requiring that the authors extensively cite your previous contributions in a \related work\" section.|To maximize probability of acceptance
correctAnswer: you submit the same paper in parallel to two conferences."
column7: Keyword: 'UNETHICAL BEHAVIORS' -> Chọn B, C, D (hoặc cả E). Hành vi phi đạo đức: (B) cướp ý tưởng chưa công bố từ seminar, (C) tác giả ma/thêm tên đồng nghiệp không đóng góp, (D) ép tác giả trích dẫn bài mình khi phản biện.

question: A researcher is a member of a program committee which decides acceptance of papers submitted to a conference and one of her PhD student submits a paper. Can the researcher be one of the reviewers of the paper?
explanation: Keyword: 'CONFLICT OF INTEREST - REVIEW OWN STUDENT' -> Chọn B (No). Thành viên ban chương trình tuyệt đối KHÔNG ĐƯỢC phản biện bài báo của chính sinh viên mình hướng dẫn do xung đột lợi ích rõ ràng.

question: A researcher is a member of a program committee which decides acceptance of papers submitted to a conference and one of her PhD student submits a paper. Can the researcher be present in the discussion about acceptance of the paper?
explanation: Keyword: 'PRESENT IN DISCUSSION OF OWN STUDENT' -> Chọn B (No). Giảng viên bắt buộc phải RÚT KHỎI PHÒNG THẢO LUẬN khi hội đồng xét duyệt bài của học trò mình để đảm bảo công bằng.

question: A researcher is acting department chair. She is a member of a national committee which decides about funding. A member of her department submits a proposal. Can she participate in discussions that involve the proposal?
explanation: Keyword: 'FUNDING COMMITTEE - OWN DEPARTMENT PROPOSAL' -> Chọn B (No). Trưởng khoa không được tham gia thảo luận hay bỏ phiếu tài trợ cho đề án do thành viên trong khoa mình đệ trình.

question: A researcher 's promotion case is discussed in a department. Her partner in life is a senior member of the department. The two are not officially married. Should the senior member participate in the discussions and vote?
explanation: Keyword: 'PARTNER PROMOTION - PARTICIPATE & VOTE' -> Chọn B (No). Người có quan hệ tình cảm/bạn đời (dù chưa kết hôn chính thức) bắt buộc phải rút khỏi phiên thảo luận và bỏ phiếu xét thăng chức.

question: Your department decides to recognize the best PhD thesis of the year with a special award. All members of the department vote their preferences. Should one be allowed to vote for the thesis of own students?
explanation: Keyword: 'VOTE FOR OWN STUDENT'S THESIS' -> Chọn B (No). Giảng viên hướng dẫn KHÔNG ĐƯỢC PHÉP bỏ phiếu bình chọn giải thưởng luận án xuất sắc nhất cho chính sinh viên của mình.

question: You are asked to review a paper submitted for publication in a journal. Can you freely copy and circulate it to your students who are working on a project on the same topic?
explanation: Keyword: 'FREELY CIRCULATE UNDER REVIEW PAPER' -> Chọn B (No). Bản thảo đang phản biện là TÀI LIỆU TUYỆT MẬT (confidential); nghiêm cấm sao chép, phát tán cho sinh viên dưới mọi hình thức.

question: You submit a paper to conference which adopts a double-blind review process. Is your identity confidential information that the conference organizers cannot disclose to reviewers?
explanation: Keyword: 'DOUBLE-BLIND CONFIDENTIAL IDENTITY' -> Chọn B (No) theo dữ liệu đề thi đánh dấu kiểm tra (nguyên lý chuẩn là Danh tính phải được giữ bí mật tuyệt đối).

question: You are a member of the program committee of a conference and participate in the discussions about acceptance of submitted papers. Later you chat with an author of an accepted paper. Can you disclose the names of the reviewers of the papers?
explanation: Keyword: 'DISCLOSE REVIEWERS NAMES (ACCEPTED)' -> Chọn B (No). Dù bài được chấp nhận hay từ chối, danh tính của các phản biện viên BẮT BUỘC PHẢI GIỮ KÍN vĩnh viễn.

question: You are a member of the program committee of a conference and participate in the discussions about acceptance of submitted papers. Later you chat with an author of a rejected paper. Can you disclose the names of the reviewers of the papers?
explanation: Keyword: 'DISCLOSE REVIEWERS NAMES (REJECTED)' -> Chọn B (No). Tuyệt đối không tiết lộ danh tính người phản biện cho tác giả của bài báo bị từ chối.

question: You are a member of a panel in charge of selecting research projects for funding. A researcher who did not succeed in the competition contacts you, asking for advice on how to write a better proposal in the future. Can you pass a copy of a successful application for reference as a good example?
explanation: Keyword: 'SHARE SUCCESSFUL PROPOSAL COPY' -> Chọn B (No). Hồ sơ đề xuất trúng tuyển là tài sản trí tuệ bảo mật của tác giả đó; thành viên hội đồng KHÔNG ĐƯỢC TỰ Ý gửi cho bên thứ ba.

question: You are asked to review a paper submitted for publication in a journal. The paper is an identical copy of a paper you previously reviewed for another journal. The paper was rejected for several serious concerns raised by the reviewers. Can your review, which recommends rejection, mention that the paper has been resubmitted with no change, completely ignoring the careful reviews received previously?
explanation: Keyword: 'MENTION RESUBMITTED WITHOUT CHANGE' -> Chọn A (Yes). Phản biện viên hoàn toàn CÓ QUYỀN nêu rõ trong báo cáo rằng bài báo đã bị nộp lại y nguyên mà phớt lờ các chỉnh sửa nghiêm trọng trước đó.

question: You are asked to review a paper. Suppose you become aware of the identity of the other reviewers. Before you form your own opinion and write your review, you would like to contact the other reviewers asking their opinion about the paper, so that your review report can be in line with theirs. Is this an acceptable practice?
explanation: Keyword: 'COLLUDE WITH OTHER REVIEWERS BEFORE REVIEW' -> Chọn B (No). Phản biện phải độc lập khách quan; liên hệ trao đổi trước với reviewer khác để viết báo cáo đồng nhất là HÀNH VI SAI PHẠM.

question: You always say no to requests to review papers from journals with very low reputation and in all cases of predatory publishing. Is this an acceptable practice?
explanation: Keyword: 'SAY NO TO PREDATORY JOURNALS' -> Chọn A (Yes). Luôn từ chối phản biện cho các tạp chí rác/săn mồi (predatory journals) là hành động ĐÚNG ĐẮN VÀ HOÀN TOÀN ĐƯỢC CHẤP NHẬN.

question: You are a successful researcher, coordinating a group with several PhD students and post-docs, and coordinating three funded research projects. You submit for publication several papers a year. To maximize your research productivity, you decide that for a few years you will not accept to review any papers. Is this an acceptable practice?
explanation: Keyword: 'NOT ACCEPT REVIEW TO MAXIMIZE PRODUCTIVITY' -> Chọn A (Yes) theo dữ liệu đề thi đánh dấu kiểm tra (nhà nghiên cứu có thể tạm thời từ chối phản biện để ưu tiên dự án).

question: You have just completed your PhD and you receive a kind invitation from journal you never heard of before to become a member of their international editorial board. This is the first invitation you receive. Without any hesitation, you accept the invitation. Is this an acceptable practice?
explanation: Keyword: 'ACCEPT UNKNOWN EDITORIAL BOARD WITHOUT HESITATION' -> Chọn B (No). Nhận lời ngay ban biên tập của tạp chí lạ chưa từng nghe tên mà không thẩm định là dấu hiệu sập bẫy tạp chí săn mồi lừa đảo.

question: Human subjects can only be the subjects of research in life sciences and social sciences.
explanation: Keyword: 'ONLY SUBJECTS IN LIFE & SOCIAL SCIENCES' -> Chọn B (No). Từ khóa 'only' là bẫy; con người còn là đối tượng nghiên cứu trọng tâm trong Khoa học máy tính (tương tác người máy HCI, trải nghiệm người dùng UI/UX).

question: Humans participating as subjects in research must be paid.
explanation: Keyword: 'MUST BE PAID' -> SAI (No). Người tham gia nghiên cứu (human subjects) tham gia trên tinh thần tự nguyện; thù lao/bồi hoàn (compensation/payment) chỉ mang tính hỗ trợ chi phí, hoàn toàn KHÔNG BẮT BUỘC (not mandatory).

question: In your research you use your students as subjects for a research experiment. Participation in the experiment is a mandatory requirement for students to pass the exam. There is nothing wrong in what you do.
explanation: Keyword: 'MANDATORY TO PASS' -> SAI (No). Ép buộc sinh viên tham gia thí nghiệm như điều kiện tiên quyết để qua môn vi phạm nghiêm trọng nguyên tắc TỰ NGUYỆN (voluntary participation) và cấu thành hành vi CƯỠNG ÉP (coercion).

question: Children can never be participating subjects in a research.
explanation: Keyword: 'NEVER BE PARTICIPATING' -> SAI (No). Từ khóa mang tính tuyệt đối 'never' thường sai. Trẻ em VẪN ĐƯỢC tham gia nghiên cứu nếu có sự chấp thuận của phụ huynh/người giám hộ (parental consent) và sự đồng ý của trẻ (assent).

question: Informed and uncoerced consent are required preconditions for participation of human subjects in research.
explanation: Keyword: 'INFORMED AND UNCOERCED CONSENT' -> ĐÚNG (Yes). Sự đồng thuận tự nguyện, không bị ép buộc (uncoerced) và được giải thích rõ ràng (informed consent) là TIỀN ĐỀ BẮT BUỘC (required preconditions) trong mọi nghiên cứu trên con người.

question: Once human subjects sign an informed consent form, the data they provide as research subjects can be freely used and disclosed by researchers, without any restriction.
explanation: Keyword: 'FREELY DISCLOSED WITHOUT RESTRICTION' -> SAI (No). Dù đã ký cam kết, dữ liệu đối tượng tham gia KHÔNG BAO GIỜ được chia sẻ tự do không kiểm soát, mà phải tuân thủ nghiêm ngặt tính BẢO MẬT (confidentiality) và QUYỀN RIÊNG TƯ (privacy).

question: The data collected from human subjects must be anonymized prior to disclosure.
explanation: Keyword: 'MUST BE ANONYMIZED PRIOR TO DISCLOSURE' -> ĐÚNG (Yes). Nguyên tắc đạo đức cốt lõi: dữ liệu cá nhân BẮT BUỘC PHẢI ĐƯỢC ẨN DANH (anonymized) trước khi công bố ra bên ngoài để bảo vệ danh tính đối tượng tham gia.

question: Once human subjects sign an informed consent form, no special procedures must be put in place to researchers to protect the data they provide as research subjects.
explanation: Keyword: 'NO SPECIAL PROCEDURES' -> SAI (No). Sau khi ký cam kết, nhà nghiên cứu BẮT BUỘC PHẢI THIẾT LẬP quy trình bảo vệ dữ liệu (data protection procedures) nghiêm ngặt, không được lơ là.

question: Once human subjects sign an informed consent form, all personal data collected by researchers about participating human subjects can be transferred without any additional constraint only to other researchers. Any other kind of disclosure is not permitted.
explanation: Keyword: 'TRANSFERRED WITHOUT RESTRICTION ONLY TO OTHER RESEARCHERS' -> SAI (No). Dữ liệu cá nhân KHÔNG ĐƯỢC chuyển giao tự do cho bất kỳ nhà nghiên cứu nào khác nếu không có thỏa thuận/sự đồng ý rõ ràng trong cam kết ban đầu.

question: To prevent identification of a participating human subject, you decide to anonymize the collected data by not disclosing the name, address and phone number. Does this always solve the problem?
explanation: Keyword: 'NOT DISCLOSING NAME, ADDRESS, PHONE' -> KHÔNG ĐỦ / SAI (No). Chỉ ẩn tên, địa chỉ, SĐT (PII cơ bản) KHÔNG ĐẢM BẢO giải quyết triệt để vấn đề nhận diện, vì danh tính vẫn có thể bị truy ngược qua kết hợp dữ liệu nhân khẩu học khác (re-identification risk).

question: My research focuses on development of new technology. Shouldn't it be intrinsically insensitive to ethical concerns?
explanation: Keyword: 'INTRINSICALLY INSENSITIVE TO ETHICAL CONCERNS' -> SAI (No). Mọi nghiên cứu phát triển công nghệ mới (AI, phần mềm, thiết bị) đều KHÔNG THỂ MIỄN NHIỄM với các vấn đề đạo đức (quyền riêng tư, an toàn người dùng).

question: My research focuses on game design, more specifically on usability of a new interactive device. May this raise ethical concerns?
explanation: Keyword: 'USABILITY OF NEW INTERACTIVE DEVICE' -> CÓ (Yes). Nghiên cứu khả năng sử dụng (usability) liên quan trực tiếp đến trải nghiệm, sức khỏe và hành vi con người nên HOÀN TOÀN CÓ THỂ gây lo ngại về đạo đức (ethical concerns).

question: My research focuses on the use of humanoid robots as a possible aid to support interaction with autistic children. May this raise ethical concerns?
explanation: Keyword: 'HUMANOID ROBOTS & AUTISTIC CHILDREN' -> CÓ (Yes). Trẻ tự kỷ là nhóm đối tượng dễ bị tổn thương (vulnerable group); can thiệp bằng robot tương tác đặt ra nhiều lo ngại đạo đức nhạy cảm về tâm lý và an toàn.

question: My research focuses on generating optimal machine code for a new special-purpose hardware. May this raise ethical concerns?
explanation: Keyword: 'OPTIMAL MACHINE CODE & SPECIAL HARDWARE' -> KHÔNG (No). Nghiên cứu tối ưu mã máy cấp thấp cho phần cứng chuyên dụng thuần túy là kỹ thuật toán học máy tính, KHÔNG trực tiếp tác động hay làm tổn hại con người nên ít/không gây lo ngại đạo đức.

question: My research focuses on sentiment analysis. I try to identify and extract subjective information by monitoring online conversations in social media and help business to understand the social sentiment. May this raise ethical concerns?
explanation: Keyword: 'SENTIMENT ANALYSIS & MONITORING ONLINE SOCIAL MEDIA' -> CÓ (Yes). Việc theo dõi, thu thập hội thoại mạng xã hội để phân tích cảm xúc đụng chạm trực tiếp đến QUYỀN RIÊNG TƯ DỮ LIỆU CÁ NHÂN (user privacy) và sự đồng thuận của người dùng.

question: What is a good way to make your academic essays longer?
options: Use some different types of paragraphs to add more body paragraphs.|Use bigger font so the paper looks longer than it is.|Repeat my major points several times in the essay.
explanation: Keyword: 'MAKE ESSAYS LONGER' -> Chọn A (Use different types of paragraphs). Để bài luận dài hơn một cách học thuật, cần đa dạng hóa các kiểu đoạn văn (narrative, compare/contrast, cause/effect) để mở rộng lập luận, tuyệt đối không dùng tiểu xảo phóng to chữ hay lặp ý vô nghĩa.

question: Argument essays should have at least how many reasons to support the argument?
explanation: Keyword: 'ARGUMENT ESSAYS - HOW MANY REASONS' -> Chọn A (3 reasons). Cấu trúc kinh điển của bài luận lập luận thường yêu cầu tối thiểu 3 luận điểm/lý do rõ ràng để tạo nên sức nặng thuyết phục.

question: Which sentence below has a correctly formatted quotation (using MLA format)?
options: He explains that they "edit and re-edit digital messages as much as they like until they decide they've perfectly conveyed their thoughts (Ghuman)."|He explains that they "edit and re-edit digital messages as much as they like until they decide they've perfectly conveyed their thoughts" (Ghuman).|He explains that they "edit and re-edit digital messages as much as they like until they decide they've perfectly conveyed their thoughts." (Ghuman).|He explains that they "edit and re-edit digital messages as much as they like until they decide they've perfectly conveyed their thoughts." (Ghuman)
explanation: Keyword: 'MLA FORMAT QUOTATION' -> Chọn B. Quy tắc chuẩn MLA: dấu ngoặc kép đóng ngay sau từ cuối cùng, sau đó là ngoặc đơn chứa tên tác giả '(Ghuman)', và dấu chấm câu kết thúc BẮT BUỘC đặt sau dấu ngoặc đơn: ...thoughts" (Ghuman).

question: Which of the following are types of paragraphs (modes of discourse) that you can use to help develop an argument essay?
options: illustration, argument, cause/effect, discussion|description, argument, compare/contrast, narrative|discussion, illustration, narrative, classification|argument, discussion, development, illustration
explanation: Keyword: 'MODES OF DISCOURSE' -> Chọn B (description, argument, compare/contrast, narrative). Bốn thể loại diễn ngôn/kiểu đoạn văn cơ bản dùng để phát triển bài luận lập luận gồm: Miêu tả, Lập luận, So sánh/Đối chiếu và Tự sự.

question: What type of body paragraph is this?
explanation: Keyword: 'TYPE OF BODY PARAGRAPH' -> Chọn C (Narration). Đoạn văn kể lại một chuỗi sự việc hoặc câu chuyện theo trình tự thời gian là đoạn văn Tự sự (Narration).

question: Which of the following are features of an advanced argument essay? Check all that apply.
options: It uses outside sources to support the argument.|It uses personal stories to develop the argument.|It uses a variety of paragraph types to develop the argument.|It uses short body paragraphs to support the argument.
explanation: Keyword: 'ADVANCED ARGUMENT ESSAY' -> Chọn A & C. Bài luận lập luận nâng cao bắt buộc phải: (A) dùng tài liệu/nguồn bên ngoài (outside sources) để chứng minh và (C) linh hoạt phối hợp nhiều dạng đoạn văn (variety of paragraph types).

question: What do you have to remember to do when you use an outside source in your academic essays? Check all that apply.
options: Cite the source.|Make the borrowed words seem like your own words.|Use correct formatting, such as MLA.|Use quotations to start the body paragraphs.
explanation: Keyword: 'OUTSIDE SOURCE IN ACADEMIC ESSAYS' -> Chọn A & C. Khi trích nguồn ngoài, bắt buộc phải: (A) Trích dẫn nguồn (Cite the source) và (C) Định dạng chuẩn chỉ theo phong cách quy định như MLA (Use correct formatting).

question: Read the original source on the left and the student's writing on the right and decide if the student plagiarized or not. Original Source: This can be seen around the world... Student's Writing: Many health agencies around the world are busy issuing dietary guidelines...
options: Yes, there is plagiarism.|No, there is not plagiarism.
explanation: Keyword: 'PLAGIARISM' -> Chọn A (Yes, there is plagiarism). Sinh viên bê nguyên cấu trúc câu và từ ngữ cốt lõi mà không đặt trong ngoặc kép trích dẫn trực tiếp -> vi phạm lỗi đạo văn diễn ngôn (paraphrasing plagiarism).

question: Read the original source on the left and the student's writing on the right and decide if the student plagiarized or not. Original Source: On the small islands... Student's Writing: Tourism is one way that small islands can survive...
options: Yes, there is plagiarism.|No, there is not plagiarism.
explanation: Keyword: 'NOT PLAGIARISM' -> Chọn B (No, there is not plagiarism). Sinh viên đã tóm tắt và diễn giải lại ý tưởng bằng văn phong riêng rất tốt kèm trích dẫn nguồn rõ ràng (Weaver).

question: It's ok to borrow some ideas from an outside source as long as you don't copy the exact words in your own essay.
explanation: Keyword: 'BORROW IDEAS' -> SAI (False). Mượn ý tưởng (ideas) dù không chép nguyên văn từ ngữ vẫn BẮT BUỘC PHẢI DẪN NGUỒN; nếu không trích nguồn thì vẫn tính là đạo văn ý tưởng.

question: To avoid plagiarism, which of the following should you do? Check all that apply.
options: Use quotations on all borrowed phrases and sentences.|Cite the source for any borrowed words or ideas.|Use quotations on all paraphrased phrases and sentences.
explanation: Keyword: 'AVOID PLAGIARISM' -> Chọn A & B. Để tránh đạo văn: (A) Bỏ dấu ngoặc kép cho mọi cụm từ/câu mượn nguyên văn và (B) Dẫn nguồn (Cite the source) cho mọi ý tưởng hay câu chữ vay mượn.

question: Which of the following can happen if a student is caught plagiarizing in an American college? Check all that apply.
options: The student can be kicked out of the school|The student can fail the class.|The student can be fined up to $100.|The student can fail the assignment.
explanation: Keyword: 'PLAGIARIZING CONSEQUENCES' -> Chọn A, B, D. Đạo văn ở đại học Mỹ có thể bị: (A) Đuổi học (kicked out), (B) Rớt môn (fail the class), hoặc (D) Trừ 0 điểm bài làm (fail the assignment); không có chuyện nộp phạt tiền $100.

question: What does synthesis mean in a synthesis essay?
explanation: Keyword: 'SYNTHESIS ESSAY' -> Chọn D (to blend). Bản chất cốt lõi của 'synthesis' là tổng hợp và HÒA TRỘN (to blend) nhiều nguồn tài liệu lại với nhau để phục vụ cho luận điểm chung.

question: What are sources used for in a synthesis essay?
options: They help to support the writer's ideas.|They make important points for the writer.|They show the reader what articles the writer read.|They make your essay longer.
explanation: Keyword: 'SOURCES IN SYNTHESIS' -> Chọn A (Support writer's ideas). Nguồn trích dẫn trong bài tổng hợp đóng vai trò làm bằng chứng CỦNG CỐ Ý TƯỞNG CỦA TÁC GIẢ (support the writer's ideas), không được để nguồn lấn át tiếng nói cá nhân.

question: Is the following quote well-integrated, or blended with the writer's own words? It was not surprising to many people that a judge decided that Robin Thicke had "noticeably ripped off Marvin Gaye's 1977 hit 'Got to Give It Up' when he wrote the smash hit 'Blurred Lines' with Pharrell Williams and T.I." (Grow).
explanation: Keyword: 'WELL-INTEGRATED QUOTE' -> ĐÚNG (Yes). Trích dẫn được ghép mượt mà, liền mạch ngữ pháp trực tiếp vào sau mệnh đề vị ngữ 'decided that...'.

question: Is the following quote well-integrated, or blended with the writer's own words? Roger Friedman explains that Mariah Carey has been in this situation before and because the "work tapes and notebooks of writing sessions have haunted Carey in other plagiarism cases," this case does not look good for her.
explanation: Keyword: 'WELL-INTEGRATED QUOTE' -> ĐÚNG (Yes). Cụm trích dẫn ngắn được lồng ghép hài hòa thành một phần mệnh đề trạng ngữ chỉ nguyên nhân 'and because the...'.

question: Is the following quote well-integrated, or blended with the writer's own words? However, they are a "representative of a different generation, one that freely mixes and matches from the whirring flood of information across new and old media, to create something new" (Kulish).
explanation: Keyword: 'WELL-INTEGRATED QUOTE' -> SAI (No). Trích dẫn nguyên một mệnh đề danh ngữ dài mà không có câu dẫn nối mượt mà tạo cảm giác rời rạc, chắp vá.

question: Is the following quote well-integrated, or blended with the writer's own words? Luckily, "the controversy did not appear to be hurting book sales. On Thursday afternoon 'Axolotl Roadkill' was ninth over all among books on the German Amazon site, albeit with many nasty postings about the plagiarism controversy." (Kulish).
explanation: Keyword: 'WELL-INTEGRATED QUOTE' -> SAI (No). Dẫn nguyên một câu dài đứng trơ trọi độc lập ngay sau từ 'Luckily', không được hòa trộn tự nhiên vào cú pháp của tác giả.

question: Is the following quote well-integrated, or blended with the writer's own words? There have been several similar cases of plagiarism at the University of Virginia, but there has been "no consistency in the way plagiarism events are handled" at that school ("UVa Expels").
explanation: Keyword: 'WELL-INTEGRATED QUOTE' -> ĐÚNG (Yes). Cụm từ trích dẫn ngắn "no consistency in the way plagiarism events are handled" được nhúng chuẩn xác vào cấu trúc ngữ pháp có sẵn của câu.

question: A documented essay can be written without using any sources.
explanation: Keyword: 'DOCUMENTED ESSAY' -> SAI (False). 'Documented essay' bản chất là bài luận có tài liệu minh chứng, do đó KHÔNG THỂ viết mà thiếu nguồn tham khảo.

question: A Works Cited entry usually starts with an author's last name.
explanation: Keyword: 'WORKS CITED ENTRY' -> ĐÚNG (True). Theo chuẩn học thuật MLA, một mục trong danh mục tài liệu tham khảo thường BẮT ĐẦU BẰNG HỌ TÁC GIẢ (author's last name).

question: A parenthetical in-text citation should always use the author's last name.
explanation: Keyword: 'PARENTHETICAL CITATION' -> SAI (False). Từ khóa tuyệt đối 'always' là bẫy; nếu nguồn không có tác giả, ta sẽ dùng tiêu đề bài viết (shortened title) chứ không nhất thiết luôn là họ tác giả.

question: A documented essay is usually an illustration or an argument essay.
explanation: Keyword: 'DOCUMENTED ESSAY' -> ĐÚNG (True). Bài luận có minh chứng tài liệu thường được triển khai dưới dạng bài luận minh họa (illustration) hoặc bài luận lập luận (argument).

question: Sources are used in documented essays to make or introduce important points in the essay.
explanation: Keyword: 'SOURCES INTRODUCE IMPORTANT POINTS' -> SAI (False). Luận điểm chính (points/claims) phải do chính tác giả nêu ra; nguồn tài liệu chỉ đóng vai trò làm DẪN CHỨNG HỖ TRỢ (evidence/support), không đứng ra giới thiệu luận điểm thay tác giả.

question: Academic essays should have only 5 paragraphs.
explanation: Keyword: 'ONLY 5 PARAGRAPHS' -> SAI (False). Quy tắc 5 đoạn văn chỉ mang tính tập viết cơ bản thời phổ thông; bài luận học thuật đại học KHÔNG BỊ GIỚI HẠN trong 5 đoạn.

question: You should use a variety of types of body paragraphs in a documented essay.
explanation: Keyword: 'VARIETY OF BODY PARAGRAPHS' -> ĐÚNG (True). Một bài luận học thuật tốt cần kết hợp linh hoạt nhiều kiểu đoạn văn (minh họa, so sánh, nhân quả, lập luận) để tăng chiều sâu.

question: How do you integrate a quote well?
options: Use several important sentences of a source.|Use only the important part of the quote and blend it with my own words.|Introduce it with a phrase, such as "Smith says," and then use only the important part of the quote.
explanation: Keyword: 'INTEGRATE A QUOTE WELL' -> Chọn B. Tích hợp trích dẫn đỉnh cao: chỉ chắt lọc phần quan trọng nhất (only the important part) rồi HÒA TRỘN TỰ NHIÊN vào câu văn của chính mình (blend with own words).

question: Which of the following internet sites would be acceptable to use when searching for sources for a research paper?
explanation: Keyword: 'ACADEMIC SEARCH ENGINES' -> Chọn D (scholar.google.com). Google Scholar là cổng tra cứu học thuật chuyên dụng; các công cụ tìm kiếm thông thường (Google, Bing, Yahoo) chỉ trả về kết quả đại trà.

question: Which of the following is NOT a very good search term for this topic? Topic: Gun Laws
options: guns|gun laws in the U.S.|the right to own a gun|gun restrictions
explanation: Keyword: 'NOT A VERY GOOD SEARCH TERM' -> Chọn A ('guns'). Từ khóa 'guns' quá chung chung và quá rộng (too broad), không thu hẹp được trọng tâm về luật lệ kiểm soát súng đạn.
